top_signals.title: Grindr Lifts Outlook, Expects to Meet 2027 Targets Ahead of Plan
top_signals.summary: Grindr Inc. raised its guidance for the current year and said it expects to meet its 2027 targets about 12 months ahead of schedule, signs the company has been succeeding in its strategy to market itself as more than just a dating app for gay men.

top_signals.title: BofA Rejigs Global Credit Trading Businesses to Boost Liquidity
top_signals.summary: Bank of America Corp. is combining its global credit macro, fixed income exchange-traded fund, and high-grade corporate bond trading businesses into a single platform as the Wall Street firm looks to streamline credit trading for clients and boost the liquidity it can offer.
